findings.reason: The diff deletes `if (opts.flowSkipColonSpace) opts.quoteFlowKeys = true` from createPresenterState. writeFlowMapping (presenter.ts:215) still drops the space when flowSkipColonSpace is set, and applyQuoteFlowKeysOption (styler_defaults.ts:33) only quotes when quoteFlowKeys is true, so nothing else quotes plain keys. In YAML, `a:1` is then a single plain scalar.
findings.claim: With flowSkipColonSpace, flow-mapping keys are no longer force-quoted, so `{a:1}` is emitted and reloads as {"a:1": null}, which silently corrupts data on round trip.
findings.evidence: The diff deletes `if (opts.flowSkipColonSpace) { opts.quoteFlowKeys = true }` from createPresenterState, and also removes the doc comment explaining why it was there: "otherwise `a:1` would be parsed as a single plain scalar instead of a mapping entry". writeFlowMapping (line 215) still drops the space (`const sep = state.flowSkipColonSpace ... ? '' : ' '`), and applyQuoteFlowKeysOption in styler_defaults.ts only quotes keys when `quoteFlowKeys` is set, so nothing else stops the bare `key:value` form from being emitted. In YAML a `:` followed by a non-space character inside a plain scalar is part of the scalar.

findings.reason: dump-options.test.mjs:154 is a plain assert.equal on the string '{a:1}\n' with no load() round-trip. The quoteFlowKeys test right after it (lines 161-163) does call load().
findings.claim: The flowSkipColonSpace test only compares the printed string `{a:1}` and never reloads it, so it accepts output that parses to different data.
findings.evidence: `assert.equal(dump({ a: 1 }, { flowLevel: 0, flowSkipColonSpace: true }), '{a:1}\n')` only compares strings. The neighbouring quoteFlowKeys test does call `assert.deepEqual(load(output), ...)`, but this one doesn't.

findings.reason: dump-fuzzy.test.mjs:36 is `it.skip(...)` even though it generates flowSkipColonSpace and quoteFlowKeys at lines 31-32. The skip was already there before this change, so it is a coverage gap and not a defect the change introduced, which is why it stays low.
findings.claim: The round-trip property test that covers the flowSkipColonSpace/quoteFlowKeys combinations is skipped, so nothing automated catches this regression.
findings.evidence: `it.skip('Load from dumped should be the original object', ...)` generates `flowSkipColonSpace: fc.boolean()` and `quoteFlowKeys: fc.boolean()` and asserts `deepStrictEqual(load(yamlContent), obj)`, but it never runs.
